players.product: UPS systems (incl. YMK modular high-power UPS), integrated power modules, precision air conditioning, lead-acid / lithium batteries and micro-modular / containerized prefabricated data-center solutions; megawatt-class UPS, 800V HVDC and SST in development

H1 2026 smart power and data-center products revenue RMB 1,526,123,515.50, up 17.52% year on year (58.89% of revenue), gross margin 33.66%; company: data-center core business growth accelerated
quarterly_data.figure: RMB 1,526,123,515.50 (+17.52% YoY); 58.89% of revenue; 33.66% gross margin

H1 2026 overseas revenue RMB 1,511,910,361.71, up 43.92% year on year, 58.35% of revenue; domestic revenue RMB 1,079,416,647.00, down 2.96%. Data-center business is mainly own-brand in China and mainly ODM overseas
quarterly_data.figure: overseas RMB 1,511,910,361.71 (+43.92% YoY, 58.35% of revenue); domestic -2.96%

quarterly_data.signal: In the IDC field the company deepened cooperation with ByteDance, Alibaba, JD.com, GDS, VNET (21Vianet), Zhonglian Data, Envision, BDC (Bridge Data Centres), Chindata and Gangcheng Yunlian, delivering data-center UPS and power-module equipment; in H1 2026 it won and delivered projects including a GDS data center, a Malaysia AI data center, the Chindata Qingyang zero-carbon data-center base, the Jingneng Horinger intelligent-computing park and the China Telecom Inner Mongolia cloud information park

Company: for next-generation power supply of high-compute data halls it is focusing on development, testing and certification of megawatt-class AC products and DC-architecture products (HVDC, SST), engaging large domestic internet cloud customers and reaching overseas compute customers through its global channels and ODM customers; it has engaged multiple key overseas customers, is sampling products, and customer certification is progressing

Company view: AI training and inference are moving mainstream rack configurations from 10-20kW per rack in general-purpose data halls to 40-80kW per rack in intelligent-computing centers, making HVDC power supply, megawatt-class high-power UPS, prefabricated smart micro-modules and full-scenario liquid cooling standard technologies for new data centers; customer demand for mid/high-voltage and mid/high-power products is growing notably

Kstar.why: Data-center power infrastructure maker (UPS, integrated power modules, precision cooling, micro-modules); data-center products were 58.89% of H1 2026 revenue and it delivers UPS and power modules to internet / IDC customers, so AI data-center build-outs drive its sales.
